title: Otter Lake Camp Resort
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Welcome to Otter Lake Camp Resort, the premier camping destination in the Pocono Mountains of Pennsylvania. Enjoy a fun, relaxing getaway that is centered around over 300 acres of pristine wilderness with a glistening 60-acre lake that is perfect for boating, swimming, and challenging fishing … (no fishing license is required).
